interpretation.non_mediation: The envelope is not subtracted from agent cost and is not a mediation or causal decomposition.
interpretation.remainder: Any difference outside the mechanical envelope remains inseparable from model interaction, repair behavior, unavailable within-task cache history, and other trajectory effects.
interpretation.scope: descriptive model-free command and environment alignment only

measured_nu1900.caveat: Counts are repeated emitted diagnostic lines, not independent vulnerabilities or defects.

mechanical_tool_exposure_envelope.method: This is a mechanical invocation-count × matched-duration timing counterfactual. It is not subtracted from agent cost, is not a mediation estimate, and does not identify behavioral feedback effects.

mismatch_ledger.bound: model-free E2a measures tool commands only; no Codex or model request is made
fresh HOME reproduces cache freshness but contains no Codex authentication material
each task/form uses its matched canonical gold successor, not an intermediate candidate edit
each sample has a fresh HOME/cache; the exact cache history at each E1 command is not retained
per-sample load is retained, but machine-cold state and unrelated host work are not controlled
fixed argv uses shell=False; pipe versus file-backed stdin semantics are retained without incidental shell text

e1_per_command_duration.reason: v3 command events have no timestamps or durations

e1_within_task_cache_state.reason: package-cache state at each retained E1 command is unavailable

internal_compiler_phase_timing.reason: ordinary dotnet commands expose no validated internal phase timing

machine_cold_state.reason: host load is observed but OS page cache and machine-cold state are uncontrolled

v3_nu1900.unit: emitted diagnostic lines, not independent defects
